title: Design: New Credit Term window with day of month looks as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Note today's date on the calendar of the location you work in (date A).
  • Work out date B: the 10th of the following month.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Open the attached design picture ct-p3-02-new-credit-term-day-of-the-following-month.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page, Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Credit Term".
  2. Type "10th of next month" in Name.
  3. Click the greyed Day box.
  4. Type 10 in the Day box.
  5. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Credit Term" window opens.

Step 2:

  • Name reads "10th of next month".

Step 3:

  • The option "Due day of the following month" becomes chosen, the cursor is in the Day box, and the Days box turns greyed and empty with pale "days after the invoice date".

Step 4:

  • The blue box reads "10th of next month means payment is due on the 10th of the following month. An invoice dated date A is due date B." (as in ct-p3-02-new-credit-term-day-of-the-following-month.png).

Step 5:

  • At 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll.
  • The layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

The two dates show as a short month and day.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • S3-R3: “A new term opens on "Due Net X days" with both boxes empty and the Day box disabled. Only the chosen option's box is active; the other is disabled and empty.”
  • S3-R4: “Clicking the disabled box chooses its option and puts the cursor in it. Switching options empties the box being left, so only the chosen option's number is checked and saved.”
  • S3-R5: “While the chosen box holds a valid number, a blue information line below the options explains the term, using today's date as the example invoice date (S3-R16):”
  • S3-R5, day of the following month line: “Day of the following month: "{Name} means payment is due on the {ordinal X} of the following month. An invoice dated {today} is due {due}." For example: "10th of next month means payment is due on the 10th of the following month. An invoice dated Oct 21 is due Nov 10."”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Valid day-of-month term typed | "{Name} means payment is due on the {ordinal X} of the following month. An invoice dated {today} is due {due}." | Blue information line, updates as the user types”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "3 New credit term and Inactive tab" ("New credit term: day of the following month"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes, except where this held design case follows the design.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ct-p3-02-new-credit-term-day-of-the-following-month.png

The design's own words:

  • “Day is active with 10; the Days box is greyed out (disabled) and empty, cleared when the option switched.”
  • “The day field reads "of the following month" beside it. Always the next month, whatever the invoice day; a shorter month uses its last day.”
